summary: Full e2e testing of GMZ Walkthrough Video Ads feature. 13/13 backend tests pass. All 10 feature flows verified. Critical note: The frontend runs `next start` (production mode) without hot reload — the new feature code was present in source files (modified Apr 11) but the build was from Apr 6. A `yarn build` + supervisor restart was required before the Walkthrough Video Ads toggle was visible in the GMZ tab. After rebuild all features work correctly.

issues: The walkthrough video container shows a black background while waiting for video.js to load the actual video — expected behavior since video.js loads an external script from api.gamemonetize.com. Not a bug, but the UX could benefit from a loading spinner/placeholder.

action_items: INFO: The frontend runs in `next start` (production mode) — NOT hot reload. Whenever source code changes are made, `yarn build` must be run in /app/frontend and the frontend supervisor must be restarted for changes to take effect. The current running build was from Apr 6; the new feature code (Apr 11 changes) was NOT visible until a rebuild was performed. This is critical: E1 must rebuild before testing/deploying any future changes.

INFO: All 119 games in DB have source=gamemonetize, so the 'non-GMZ game does NOT show Walkthrough button' test case cannot be verified with a real game. Code logic is correct (button only renders when gmzHash is set, and gmzHash only set when source===gamemonetize && embed_url exists), but recommend adding at least 1 non-GMZ game to verify end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL: Frontend running `next start` (production build) without hot reload. Source changes require `yarn build` + supervisor restart to take effect. This was the root cause of the feature not being visible initially in this test run.

NOTE: settings.gmz_video_ads_enabled is compared as string in game-player.tsx: `settings.gmz_video_ads_enabled !== 'false'` — this correctly defaults to `true` when the key is not yet set in DB (since undefined !== 'false' is true). Correct behavior.

NOTE: The public /api/games list endpoint returns source=null for all games (uses GameFeedResponse which may exclude source). The individual /api/games/{id} endpoint correctly returns source=gamemonetize. Game player uses individual endpoint so it works correctly.
NOTE: gmzPage prop is passed to GameMonetizeTab but is destructured but never used in the component body (only gmzTotal/gmzHasMore are used for display). Minor dead prop.

rca_of_issue: Root Cause of initial test failure (Walkthrough Video Ads not visible): The frontend server runs `next start` in PRODUCTION mode. This serves a pre-compiled `.next/` build directory. The build in `.next/server/app/admin/page.js` was last compiled on Apr 6 06:20 UTC, while the GameMonetizeTab.tsx source was updated on Apr 11. Since `next start` has no hot reload, the new code was never compiled into the running bundle. Fix applied: ran `yarn build` in /app/frontend to regenerate the bundle, then restarted the frontend supervisor. After this, the feature was visible and working correctly.
